criteria.assertion: Independently pin exact helper, collector and full candidate bytes before parsing. No private-source execution/import/compilation or private body/path publication.

Extract actual Same field equality semantics and recompute all35 before/after pairs plus named/opened executable comparisons; distinguish exact comparator field set from every JSON field and retain12access-time-only differences.

Trace Named/GetInfo handle access/share/disposition/flags and identity/plain metadata source, error propagation and cleanup/disposal. Inspect actual API use without claiming native behavior from source alone.

Trace Hash stopwatch/cancellation creation, open and before/during/after metadata order, size/cap/chunk/EOF checks, synchronous/asynchronous waits and exact disposal order. Identify post-return deadline and late-output consequences without inventing a hard bound.

Recompute collector acceptance from actual helper semantics and exact record, not merely reported flags. Preserve recorded rejection, historical source-hash limitations, missing complete executable/dependency/ancestor qualification and native HOLD.

Keep private collector/helper separate from canonical inventory/wrapper/writer predicates and prior accepted repairs. Propose only an actual independently justified canonical behavior defect; production paths require explicit root allocation. No atime waiver/restoration or copied private implementation.

For an allocated correction, freeze meaningful observable source controls, original tests/negative controls and failing source receipts, then independently test exact author freeze with inert ports only. No native source import or target process execution.

Preserve source/context/contract/catalog/lock/migration/frozen evidence accounting and full R2 scope; state exact reviewed source/packet hashes, passed/failed/unrun and physical-evidence limitations; bounded ordinary checks leave no owned jobs.

Respect latest PG403 restriction: no metadata rerouting via host/mirror/relay/local computer, no repeated failed research or manufactured fixture work. If no supported independent change remains, return precise prerequisites.
